ops.body: DAEMONKIT (StableProgramFrom) REVIEW VERDICT: locking/atomic-write/crash-recovery all clean; ONE MAJOR confirmed-latent design gap — mixed-policy name collision: a StableProgramFrom caller silently clobbers a version-gated StableProgram stage on the same name and stamps Build "unversioned", after which Release builds can never reclaim it (Release.Newer loses to the parsed zero-value Dev; only dev builds win it back — asymmetry proving unintentional). Disjoint names are convention-only today. DECISION: policy tag in the sidecar meta refusing cross-policy overwrite in both directions (make-invalid-states-unrepresentable, no silent clobber), plus a digest-path concurrency/convergence test (coverage gap vs the sibling's race test) and single-read materialization to close the source double-read TOCTOU window. All queued to the same fable lane/worktree alongside the applyRolledBack fix — one v0.20.7 review bundle. Scoreboard: cc-notes CLEAN, captain-hook clean (daemonkit applyRolledBack gap being fixed), synckit blocker correction in flight, daemonkit = this verdict (fixes queued), fusekit verdict pending.
